name: Derelict Spaceship
worldRules: The ship has been adrift for 50 years
Some areas are exposed to vacuum
The AI system is partially functional

airlock.name: Airlock Chamber
airlock.description: A cramped airlock with flickering emergency lights. Your EVA suit's helmet display shows the atmosphere is breathable but stale.

corridor_a.name: Main Corridor A
corridor_a.description: A long corridor stretches into darkness. Debris floats in the low gravity. Emergency signs point to various sections.

command_center.name: Command Center
command_center.description: The bridge of the vessel. Consoles flicker with residual power. A large viewport shows the endless void of space.

cargo_bay.name: Cargo Bay
cargo_bay.description: A massive cargo hold filled with crates and containers. Some have been torn open. Strange markings cover the walls.
